all: China grants RMB 103 million to WFP for humanitarian interventions in Somalia
Chinese Government donates $10 million to WFP for drought relief in Somalia
Chinese Government donates 500,000 Sinopharm Covid-19 vaccine doses worth $9 million in December 2021
China donates $6 million worth of equipment to Somalia for humanitarian relief
China cancels $3 million debt owed by Somalia [Linked to #2285]
China donates humanitarian supplies to the Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs and Disaster Management in Somalia
Chinese Government donates 200,000 Sinopharm Covid-19 vaccine doses worth $3.6 million in April 2021
China grants $2 million in food aid to Somalia through WFP (Linked to project #52398)
Chinese Government grants $2 million to UNICEF to relieve humanitarian crisis in Somalia
China Donated $2 Million to United Nations Assistance Mission in Somalia
